search_text: published ZDI-08-060 ZDI-CAN-304 Apple QuickTime AVC1 Atom Parsing Heap Overflow Vulnerability 2008-09-09 CVE-2008-3627 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-3627 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime Player. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists in the parsing of AVC1 atoms. An integer overflow condition is present that can result in a heap chunk being under-allocated. This heap corruption can be further leveraged to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current user. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Apple QuickTime AVC1 Atom Parsing Heap Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime Player. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists in the parsing of AVC1 atoms. An integer overflow condition is present that can result in a heap chunk being under-allocated. This heap corruption can be further leveraged to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current user.
